reading_method.method: Read full rendered primary from title to final provenance source pins through 14 overlapping viewport screenshots at normal reader size. Inspected all three actual embedded pictures across their entire displayed areas, the intervening prose, closing lines, refinement record and variant/provenance notes. Accessibility text supported exact wording; screenshots supplied actual layout and picture inspection. No prose or image edits.
reading_method.coverage: Complete primary and all end matter; no distinct meaningful narrative alternative is present. Reversed Chapter 10 is documented as a paragraph-order duplicate, not a competing ending or extra scene.
reading_method.display: Comfortable serif text column approximately 760 pixels wide; artwork approximately 960 pixels wide. No broken images, clipped text or interrupted dialogue attribution observed.
